title: GitHub Actions 流水线
html:
GitHub Actions 流水线

核心概念

持续集成（CI）和持续部署（CD）是将代码变更从开发者本地安全、快速地交付到生产环境的自动化流程。在前端领域，CI/CD 涵盖了代码检查、类型检查、测试、构建、部署的完整链路。

flowchart LR
    PUSH[代码推送] --> LINT[Lint<br/>代码检查]
    LINT --> TYPE[TypeCheck<br/>类型检查]
    TYPE --> TEST[Test<br/>单元/集成测试]
    TEST --> BUILD[Build<br/>构建产物]
    BUILD --> E2E[E2E Test<br/>端到端测试]
    E2E --> DEPLOY[Deploy<br/>部署上线]

基础 CI 流水线

# .github/workflows/ci.yml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Code Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm run lint

      - name: Type Check
        run: pnpm run typecheck

      - name: Format Check
        run: pnpm run format:check

  test:
    name: Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: pnpm run test --run --coverage

      - name: Upload Coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage/lcov.info

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Upload Build Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: apps/web/.next/
          retention-days: 1

  e2e:
    name: E2E Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Download Build Artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: apps/web/.next/

      - name: Run E2E Tests
        run: pnpm run test:e2e
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7

Monorepo CI 优化

在 Monorepo 中，全量构建所有包既浪费时间又浪费资源。Turborepo 的 --filter 可以实现按需构建。

基于变更的按需构建

# .github/workflows/ci-monorepo.yml
name: Monorepo CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      web: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.web }}
      admin: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.admin }}
      ui: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.ui }}
      shared: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.shared }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: changes
        with:
          filters: |
            web:
              - 'apps/web/**'
              - 'packages/ui/**'
              - 'packages/shared/**'
            admin:
              - 'apps/admin/**'
              - 'packages/ui/**'
              - 'packages/shared/**'
            ui:
              - 'packages/ui/**'
            shared:
              - 'packages/shared/**'

  ci-web:
    name: CI - Web App
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.web == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: npx turbo run lint typecheck test build --filter=@myapp/web

  ci-admin:
    name: CI - Admin App
    needs: detect-changes
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.admin == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: npx turbo run lint typecheck test build --filter=@myapp/admin

缓存策略

graph TD
    CACHE[缓存策略]
    CACHE --> PNPM[pnpm store<br/>依赖包缓存]
    CACHE --> TURBO[Turborepo 远程缓存<br/>构建产物缓存]
    CACHE --> NEXT[Next.js 构建缓存<br/>.next/cache]
    CACHE --> PW[Playwright 浏览器缓存]

不同缓存层的命中条件与失效策略不同，选错缓存键会导致"缓存假命中"——用旧产物掩盖新问题。

缓存层 缓存内容 失效条件
pnpm store 依赖包 pnpm-lock.yaml 变化
Turborepo 远程缓存 构建产物 源码或依赖图变化（基于内容哈希）
Next.js 构建缓存 .next/cache 源码变化（按哈希 key 分层退化）
Playwright 浏览器缓存 浏览器二进制 Playwright 版本变化

Turborepo 远程缓存

- name: Build with Turbo Cache
  run: npx turbo run build --cache-dir=.turbo
  env:
    TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
    TURBO_TEAM: ${{ vars.TURBO_TEAM }}

Next.js 构建缓存

- name: Cache Next.js Build
  uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: |
      apps/web/.next/cache
    key: nextjs-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}-${{ hashFiles('apps/web/**/*.ts', 'apps/web/**/*.tsx') }}
    restore-keys: |
      nextjs-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}-
      nextjs-${{ runner.os }}-

PR 状态检查

# .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml
name: PR Checks

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  bundle-analysis:
    name: Bundle Size Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run build

      - name: Analyze Bundle
        uses: andresz1/size-limit-action@v1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          build_script: build
          skip_step: build

  lighthouse:
    name: Lighthouse CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run build

      - name: Run Lighthouse
        uses: treosh/lighthouse-ci-action@v12
        with:
          configPath: './lighthouserc.json'
          uploadArtifacts: true

部署流水线

# .github/workflows/deploy.yml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  deploy-preview:
    name: Deploy Preview
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run build

      - name: Deploy to Vercel Preview
        uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v25
        with:
          vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}

  deploy-production:
    name: Deploy Production
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run build

      - name: Deploy to Vercel Production
        uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v25
        with:
          vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
          vercel-args: '--prod'

小结

  • CI/CD 流水线覆盖 Lint → TypeCheck → Test → Build → E2E → Deploy 完整链路。
  • Monorepo 中使用 paths-filter 和 Turborepo --filter 实现按需构建。
  • 缓存策略（pnpm store、Turborepo 远程缓存、Next.js 构建缓存）显著减少 CI 时间。
  • PR 状态检查（Bundle Size、Lighthouse）提供可视化的质量指标。
  • concurrency 配置避免同一分支的多次推送导致重复执行。
